name: PyTorch Inductor: torch/_inductor - ML compiler for PyTorch
notes: PyTorch Inductor is a deep learning compiler that generates fast code for PyTorch models. Part of PyTorch since 2.2. Contains autoheuristic, codegen, compile_worker, fx_passes, heuristics, kernel, runtime, template_heuristics subsystems. Supports Triton backend for GPU code generation. 104k stars on main PyTorch repo.
